verified_experience: SOURCES DISAGREE, reported honestly rather than reconciled by guesswork. Apollo's own profile states 20 years of experience; Practo states 14 years. Her published training timeline is MBBS 2007, MD General Medicine 2011 (both Osmania Medical College, Hyderabad) and DM Cardiology 2015 (Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad) - which is about 19 years since MBBS and about 11 years as a cardiologist as of 2026. Treat 'about 19 years in medicine, about 11 as a DM cardiologist' as the defensible reading.
hni_signals: Strong seniority and society standing. (1) SOCIETY OFFICE: Ex-Joint Secretary of the Cardiological Society of India, Telangana Chapter - an elected professional office, exactly the signal the brief asks for. (2) INTERNATIONAL FELLOWSHIP: FSCAI, Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions, a US interventional cardiology body. (3) THREE CONCURRENT PRACTICE LOCATIONS: Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills, Vivekananda Hospital Begumpet, and PSR Heart Care Somajiguda - multi-site practice is a direct HNI marker under the brief. (4) HIGH-FEE INTERVENTIONAL WORK: OCT/IVUS-guided angioplasty and FFR are premium imaging-guided coronary intervention techniques, not routine cardiology. (5) INTERNATIONAL PATIENT STREAM: Apollo publishes a dedicated International Patient Services profile for her, i.e. the group markets her to overseas self-paying patients. (6) ELITE TRAINING: MBBS and MD at Osmania Medical College, DM Cardiology at NIMS. (7) Vivekananda Hospital states she 'has successfully treated thousands of patients with various cardiac conditions' - quoted verbatim; no numeric procedure volume was published and none was estimated. NOTE ON owns_clinic: set FALSE. PSR Heart Care is a clinic she practises at, but nothing published shows she owns or founded it, and the name does not correspond to her initials. A human should check PSR Heart Care's ownership - if it is hers, this becomes a much stronger HNI row.

notes: SOURCE-DATA DISCREPANCY - THE HOSPITAL IN THE SOURCE ROW IS NOT CONFIRMED, AND THE CALLER'S HYPOTHESIS WAS RIGHT. The row lists her at Citi Neuro Centre, Banjara Hills. TWO independent negative checks were run: (a) a quoted search for 'Ramya Pechetty' together with 'Citi Neuro' / 'Citi Neuro Centre' returned ZERO results connecting the two, and (b) a search restricted to allowed_domains citineurocentre.com for her name returned only generic hospital and cardiology-department pages, with no profile for her. Her actual, repeatedly published affiliations are Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills (primary), Vivekananda Hospital Begumpet, and PSR Heart Care Somajiguda - none of them Citi Neuro. In the very first search a Skedoc page titled 'Doctors in Citi Neuro Centre, Banjara Hills' did appear, but that was a topical match on the words in my own query, not evidence she is on that roster; the ClinicSpots roster for Citi Neuro Banjara Hills names Dr J Rao, Dr Deepak Nookala, Dr A Vamshidhar, Dr V Chud, Dr B.S. Reddy and Dr Rathna Kishore, and she is not among them. TREAT THE CITI NEURO LABEL ON THIS ROW AS IMPRECISE SOURCE DATA. IDENTITY IS NEVERTHELESS SOLID: 'Pechetty' is a rare surname and THREE input facts match - name, specialty Cardiology, and city Hyderabad - across two different hospitals' own official sites. She is a real, well-documented, single individual; no same-name cardiologist competed with her anywhere in results, so this is NOT an ambiguous match. BAND = HIGH, and this is a genuine High rather than the usual single-source Medium: TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL SOURCES agree - apollohospitals.com (Apollo's own site, counting once across apollohospitals.com and apollo247.com per the brief's one-group-one-source rule) AND vivekanandahospital.in, a completely separate hospital organisation publishing its own personnel page for her. Practo, Skedoc, LogintoHealth and Bangla Health Connect are corroborating-only and were not counted. NO PERSONAL EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED. The only email recorded is info@vivekanandahospital.in, which is Vivekananda Hospital's GENERAL enquiry address, correctly placed in hospital_email and never presented as her own line. It passed the mandatory exact-phrase re-check: a quoted search for 'info@vivekanandahospital.in' returned the hospital's own contacts page https://vivekanandahospital.in/contacts/ plus a Medindia directory entry. PHONE NUMBERS DELIBERATELY DISCARDED: a search summary asserted a block of seven or eight Vivekananda numbers, but I did NOT exact-phrase re-check them individually, and per the brief a summary-asserted contact is unconfirmed until re-checked - so none were recorded. A human can read them off the hospital contacts page URL given in indirect_details. CITI NEURO CENTRE URL PATTERN FINDING, for the ~60 Citi Neuro rows that follow - see the fuller statement in this batch's report: NEITHER Citi Neuro domain publishes per-doctor profile pages. citineurocentre.com carries a single combined roster at https://citineurocentre.com/doctors/ plus department pages such as /department/, /best-cardiology-hospital-in-hyderabad/, /interventional-cardiology/, /noninvasive-cardiology/ and /best-cardiologists-hospital-citi-neuro-centre/. The older static site cityneurocenter.com carries a single roster at http://www.cityneurocenter.com/our-doctors.html . There is no /doctor/<name-slug> family on either domain, so for Citi Neuro doctors the hospital_profile field will usually have to stay blank and enrichment must lean on aggregators (Practo, Skedoc, ClinicSpots) and on the doctor's OTHER hospital affiliations. Citi Neuro also runs multiple branches - Banjara Hills, Uppal, Miyapur and Tirumalgherry - so branch labels in the source list cannot be resolved from URLs the way Yashoda's can.
